clips.title: Talking About Chef Ryuji
grammar: 〜てくれる — doing something for someone

lines.en: Who is Ryuji?
lines.speaker: Hamaie

lines.en: A culinary researcher.
lines.speaker: Yamauchi

lines.en: Wait, 5.41 million YouTube subscribers?
lines.speaker: Hamaie

lines.en: That's incredible.
lines.speaker: Yamauchi

lines.en: Just with cooking?
lines.speaker: Hamaie

lines.en: I watch his videos all the time.
lines.speaker: Yamauchi

lines.en: Whoa!
lines.speaker: Hamaie

lines.ja: すっげー美味そうなんなんか作ってくれはんねん。
lines.en: He makes all kinds of super delicious-looking dishes.
lines.speaker: Yamauchi

lines.en: They've gotten expensive... even meat buns.
lines.speaker: Yamauchi

lines.en: 250 yen? They used to be 100 yen.
lines.speaker: Hamaie

lines.ja: 俺らの子どもの頃は100円やったな。あんまん80円とかやったな。
lines.en: When we were kids, they were 100 yen. Red bean buns were like 80 yen.
lines.speaker: Yamauchi

lines.en: Right, exactly!
lines.speaker: Hamaie

lines.ja: めっちゃ昔の人やん俺ら！
lines.en: We sound like people from ancient history!
lines.speaker: Yamauchi

lines.ja: お祭りの当てくじも前100円だったよ。
lines.en: Festival raffle games used to be 100 yen too.
lines.speaker: Hamaie

lines.en: Back in the day, yeah.
lines.speaker: Yamauchi

clips.title: Working Since 7 in the Morning
grammar: 〜しゃあない — it can't be helped / no wonder

lines.ja: うわ、ココナッツのあの…グリーンカレー！
lines.en: Whoa, that coconut... green curry!
lines.speaker: Yamauchi

lines.ja: あ、グリーンカレーまんやからな。
lines.en: Well yeah, it's a green curry bun.
lines.speaker: Hamaie

lines.en: I've been working since early morning!
lines.speaker: Yamauchi

lines.ja: 朝の7時から働いてんねん、今日。
lines.en: We've been working since 7 AM today.
lines.speaker: Hamaie

lines.ja: そうや、そうや。ロケしてきてんねん。
lines.en: That's right, exactly. We've been shooting on location.
lines.speaker: Yamauchi

lines.ja: もう今20時やろ？ で、これ22時まで撮んねんやろ？
lines.en: It's already 8 PM, right? And we're filming this until 10 PM?
lines.speaker: Yamauchi

lines.ja: そらもうお前、グリーンカレーまんかどうか分からへんなるのしゃあないやろ！
lines.en: Then it's no wonder you can't tell whether it's a green curry bun or not!
lines.speaker: Yamauchi
